# Installing Quanteda package and the rest of necessary libraries

```{r}
install.packages("readtext")
library(quanteda)
library(readtext)
library(tidyverse)

```


#Importing my article text dataframe
```{r}
articles <- read_csv("articles_df_china.csv")
```

# Creating my_corpus using the 'sentence' column as the text field

```{r}
my_corpus <- corpus(articles, text_field = "sentence") 
head(my_corpus)


```

## KWIC search. The keywords and phrases are chosen in quanteda_test2 table. 

```{r}

# Tokenize the corpus
my_tokens <- tokens(my_corpus)

# Perform KWIC (Key Word in Context) search on the tokens
quanteda_test <- kwic(my_tokens, pattern = "women", valuetype = "regex") %>% 
  as.data.frame()

quanteda_test2 <- kwic(my_tokens, phrase(c("women", "Uyghur women", "Kazakh women", "Xinjiang women", "reproductive", "abortion", "sterilization", "human rights", "testimony", "activism")), window = 14, valuetype = "regex") %>% as.data.frame() 

write.csv(quanteda_test, "quanteda_test.csv")

```



# Housecleaning 
```{r}
#cut useless returns
XJjunk <- c("NA")
quanteda_west <- quanteda_test2 %>%
  filter(!keyword %in% XJjunk)


#Eliminate duplication
quanteda_west <- quanteda_test2   %>% 
  distinct(docname, pre, keyword, post) %>% 
  rename('Beginning of Passage' = pre, 'End of Passage' = post) 

quanteda_test2 <- quanteda_west  %>%
  add_column(Code = NA) %>% 
  add_column(Comments = NA) %>% 
  select(docname, 'Beginning of Passage', keyword, 'End of Passage', Code, Comments)

write_csv(kwic_with_metadata_csv, "../exercises/assets/data/kwic_with_metadata.csv")

```
